files.transform: gunzip of the single upstream table; kept the gene_biotype == 'protein_coding' rows whose mean count across the 60 samples is >= 5 (14616 of 56299 rows); kept ensembl_gene_id and external_gene_id (renamed gene_symbol) verbatim, dropped description and gene_biotype, dropped no samples, and left every count unchanged. Rows sorted by Ensembl id, sample columns in upstream order.

one row per upstream sample column, in upstream order; cell_line, population_doubling, rotenone (treated/untreated) and replicate decoded from the upstream column names by fetch.py (MRC5_PD38w_2 -> MRC5 38 treated 2; HFF_PD22_woRotenone3 -> HFF 22 untreated 3) and cross-checked against the design of the series: 10 (cell line, population doubling) strata x 3 treated + 3 untreated = 60 samples.
